verses.1: And David spoke to the LORD with these words on the day when the LORD saved him from all his enemies and from Saul’s hand.
verses.2: And the LORD said, “Sweep away my enemies and my adversaries.”
verses.3: O God of my creation, save me from my troubles. O Lord of my salvation, deliver me from my enemies. O Savior of me, rescue me from the flames of destruction.
verses.4: I will praise the LORD, and I will be saved from my enemies.
verses.5: For I am surrounded by the gates of death; my fields are barren, and I am in despair.
verses.6: The ropes of Shaul Sabuni, they are before me; the chains of death.
verses.7: In my distress, I will call out to Jehovah. I will call out to my God. He will hear my voice and my cries in His ears.
verses.8: And the earth was filled with noise and turmoil. The heavens were also in turmoil, as if they were being torn apart by force.
verses.9: Smoke rose from his mouth, and fire came out of it. It would eat the grass in the fields.
verses.10: And he raised the heavens, and he descended; and the clouds covered his feet.
verses.11: And he mounted the back of a bird, and flew away. He saw everything from the wings of the bird.
verses.12: And darkness covered its surroundings; it was a place filled with thick water and muddy surfaces.
verses.13: From its mouth, flames of fire spewed forth.
verses.14: The LORD will thunder from heaven, and His voice will be heard above.
verses.15: And he sent arrows, and they were scattered by the wind.
verses.16: And the waves of the sea rose from their positions in the depths of the sea, as a result of the anger of Jehovah. It was caused by the spirit of Apo.
verses.17: From the midst of the noise, he will take me away from many waters.
verses.18: Save me from my enemies, those who hate me, for they have spoken evil of me.
verses.19: Please be kind to me on the day of my death. May Jehovah be my refuge.
verses.20: And he went out to the wide place, to rescue me, because he wanted me.
verses.21: May the LORD reward me according to my righteousness. May He restore me to my place of honor.
verses.22: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and I have not sinned against any of His gods.
verses.23: For all his judgments are against me, and his laws do not prohibit me from doing whatever I want.
verses.24: And I will be pure to him, and I will be free from his control.
verses.25: And Jehovah will sit with me in my righteousness, just as my ancestors did, before His eyes.
verses.26: With a righteous person, there will be mercy; with a good ruler, there will be peace.
verses.27: With sorrow, it will be destroyed; with difficulty, it will be broken.
verses.28: And I will save the poor people, and your eyes will be satisfied with truth.
verses.29: For you are the Lord, and the Lord will illuminate my darkness.
verses.30: For in this land, God has made it great and powerful.
verses.31: The Lord makes His ways pure. This is the word of the LORD. He is a shield for all those who trust in Him.
verses.32: For no one can exist apart from Jehovah, and no creature can be created apart from our God.
verses.33: The Lord made the clouds move, and He guided my path.
verses.34: My feet are like lepers, and he will stand over my remains.
verses.35: My hands are trained for battle; my seeds have been sown.
verses.36: And she gave me your protection and your help.
verses.37: He will expand my steps; he will lift me up, and my crutches will not be needed anymore.
verses.38: I will pursue those who oppose me and destroy them. I will not return until they are completely destroyed.
verses.39: And they ate them, and they became weak. They couldn’t get up anymore, and they fell under my feet.
verses.40: May the army help me in battle; may it decide my fate beneath me.
verses.41: And my enemies will be defeated by my power and strength.
verses.42: They are saved, but there is no one to save them from Jehovah. They do not receive any help from Him.
verses.43: And I will break them like the rocks of the earth, like the fragments of stone. I will destroy them completely.
verses.44: May my enemies be driven away from me, and may they not be able to harm me. May the nations that do not know me serve me instead.
verses.45: The children of Nekhar will be able to hear me; they will listen to me.
verses.46: The children of Necho will be destroyed and trapped in their own prisons.
verses.47: May the Lord live! Blessed be Zuri and Yarum, the gods of Zuri. May they save me.
verses.48: The God who brings retribution upon me, and who subjugates nations under my rule.
verses.49: And let me be freed from my enemies and from my situation. Please save me from those who are evil to me.
verses.50: Therefore, Jehovah will bless you in all nations, and by your name I will praise Him.
verses.51: From above, He saves His kings and does mercy for His Messiah, for David and his descendants, forever.
